name: [FinOps][Protective] Azure OpenAI token burn rate spike

esqlQuery.esql: FROM metrics-azure_openai.metrics-* | WHERE azure.open_ai.token_transaction.total IS NOT NULL | STATS tokens_15m = SUM(azure.open_ai.token_transaction.total) BY azure.resource.name | WHERE tokens_15m > 5000000 | SORT tokens_15m DESC
